summary: Frontend-only testing of new Contact page (/contact) plus sanity check of Home (/) and Events (/events) after shared site.ts config change. All Contact page requirements verified: page loads with 'Get in touch' tag and 'Contact' h1; Event Details section shows exactly 4 rows (Date=10th October 2026, Registration Deadline=25th September 2026, Venue=full address, Reporting Time=8:00 a.m.); Get in Touch section has Email Us card (href='mailto:shisfest@scottishigh.com', target=_blank, rel=noopener), Follow @shisfest26 Instagram card (correct href), and Teacher In-Charge row showing 'Ms. Simran Yadav' as plain text (confirmed NOT wrapped in an <a> tag); full-page text scan found zero phone-number-like digit sequences (7+ digits) anywhere on the page. Registration section shows exactly 2 PassCard-style cards in a .reg-group container (School Registration -> groupRegistration form link, Register Individually -> individualRegistration form link), both with target=_blank/rel=noopener. Mobile viewport (375px) verified: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==viewport width), info-row correctly stacks to flex-direction:column on venue row, reg-group cards remain tap-friendly and legible. No console errors on Contact page. Home page sanity check: title, tagline, 3 featured preview event cards (Slam Poetry, Tamasha, BioFlix) render correctly, no console errors. Events page sanity check: 26 cards + 15 filter chips render, clicking 'View Event' opens the EventModal correctly with full rules/criteria content (Slam Poetry checked) - config change did not break Home/Events.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact.tsx is clean, small, and correctly reuses PassCard and .info-list/.info-row styles - no code smells found.
site.ts additive changes (eventDetails, teacherInCharge, contactEmail, urls.email) did not touch existing fields used by Home/Events - verified no regression on those pages.

Note: on the Home page, could not find literal text 'View all events' via get_by_text - the link text/label may differ slightly (e.g., icon-only or different wording), but this is pre-existing behavior from iteration_1 (untouched by this session) and preview cards + navigation still function; not a new regression, just flagging as informational since it wasn't the current task's focus.
